import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    x = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Identify near-duplicates (correlation >= 0.6)
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(ids[j])
    
    # Filter out near-duplicates
    keep_idx = [i for i in range(len(ids)) if ids[i] not in to_remove]
    keep_ids = [ids[i] for i in keep_idx]
    keep_x = x[:, keep_idx]
    
    # Compute effect sizes (mean difference by outcome)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(keep_ids):
        group0 = keep_x[y==0, i]
        group1 = keep_x[y==1, i]
        mean_diff = np.mean(group1) - np.mean(group0)
        effect_sizes.append(abs(mean_diff))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1]
    top_features = [keep_ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check for strong associations with outcome using t-test
    drivers = []
    for fid in top_features:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        group0 = x[y==0, idx]
        group1 = x[y==1, idx]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1, equal_var=False)
        if abs(t_stat) > 2.5:  # Strong association
            drivers.append(fid)
    
    # If no strong drivers found, return empty design
    if not drivers:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build regression components
    columns = tuple(top_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    products = ()
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in columns}
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
